science.title: Built from high-density human performance data.
science.body: Thalos is developed around a 26-week real-world performance study with strength athletes in Vienna. The goal is simple: understand how training, nutrition, recovery and biomarkers interact over time — and translate that complexity into better coaching. The data layer includes workout logs, nutrition tracking, wearable signals, glucose data, lactate measurements, blood panels, microbiome analysis, body composition and performance testing. This is science made usable. Not a dashboard. Not a generic fitness app. A performance system.
science.disclaimer: Thalos is a performance and fitness coaching platform. It does not provide medical diagnoses or therapy recommendations.
